item.title: Kazakhstan Boosts January Oil Exports to Germany
item.description: The Astana Times provides news and information from Kazakhstan and around the world. Of these shipments, 106,000 tons were transported via the Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan (BTC) pipeline, reported Reuters on Feb. 3.
